verses.en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.pt: Junto aos rios da Babilônia nos sentamos e choramos, enquanto nos lembramos de Sião.
verses.en_web: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.en_bbe: By the rivers of Babylon we were seated, weeping at the memory of Zion,

verses.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.pt: Sobre os salgueiros que há no meio dela penduramos nossas harpas.
verses.en_web: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
verses.en_bbe: Hanging our instruments of music on the trees by the waterside.

verses.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.pt: Porque ali os que tinham nos capturado nos pediam letras de canções, e os que nos destruíram, que os alegrássemos, dizendo: Cantai para nós algumas das canções de Sião.
verses.en_web: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
verses.en_bbe: For there those who had taken us prisoners made request for a song; and those who had taken away all we had gave us orders to be glad, saying, Give us one of the songs of Zion.

verses.en: How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?
verses.pt: Como cantaríamos canções do SENHOR em terra estrangeira?
verses.en_web: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?
verses.en_bbe: How may we give the Lord's song in a strange land?

verses.en: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.pt: Se eu me esquecer de ti, ó Jerusalém, que minha mão direita se esqueça de sua habilidade.
verses.en_web: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
verses.en_bbe: If I keep not your memory, O Jerusalem, let not my right hand keep the memory of its art.

verses.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.pt: Que minha língua grude no céu da boca se eu não me lembrar de ti, se eu não pôr Jerusalém acima de todas as minhas alegrias.
verses.en_web: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you; if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.en_bbe: If I let you go out of my thoughts, and if I do not put Jerusalem before my greatest joy, let my tongue be fixed to the roof of my mouth.

verses.en: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.pt: Lembra-te, SENHOR, dos filhos de Edom no dia de Jerusalém, que diziam: Arruinai -a,arruinai -a,até ao seus fundamentos!
verses.en_web: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom, the day of Jerusalem; who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, keep in mind against the children of Edom the day of Jerusalem; how they said, Let it be uncovered, uncovered even to its base.

verses.en: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.pt: Ah filha de Babilônia, que serás destruída! Bem-aventurado a quem te retribuir o que fizeste conosco.
verses.en_web: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who rewards you, as you have served us.
verses.en_bbe: O daughter of Babylon, whose fate is destruction; happy is the man who does to you what you have done to us.

verses.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado aquele que tomar dos teus filhos, e lançá-los contra as pedras. Salmo de Davi:
verses.en_web: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man who takes your little ones, crushing them against the rocks.
